definitions.explanation: A reduction in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy measure. Composed of {利|り} (interest) + {下|さ}げ (lowering).

examples.japanese: {中央|ちゅうおう}{銀行|ぎんこう}が{利下|りさ}げを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: The central bank decided on an interest rate cut.

examples.japanese: {利下|りさ}げの{影響|えいきょう}で{株価|かぶか}が{上昇|じょうしょう}した。
examples.english: Stock prices rose due to the effect of the rate cut.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}{後退|こうたい}を{防|ふせ}ぐために、{大幅|おおはば}な{利下|りさ}げが{実施|じっし}される{見通|みとお}しだ。
examples.english: A significant rate cut is expected to be implemented to prevent an economic downturn.

notes:
USAGE:
{利下|りさ}げ is a noun often used in news and financial reporting. It can also be used with する: {利下|りさ}げする (to cut interest rates). The word is frequently seen in headlines about central bank policy decisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利下|りさ}げを{行|おこな}う (carry out a rate cut)
- {大幅|おおはば}な{利下|りさ}げ (significant rate cut)
- {追加|ついか}{利下|りさ}げ (additional rate cut)
- {利下|りさ}げ{幅|はば} (size of the rate cut)

RELATED TERMS:
- {利上|りあ}げ is the opposite, meaning an interest rate hike.
- {金利|きんり} means interest rate.
- {金融|きんゆう}{緩和|かんわ} means monetary easing, a broader policy that includes rate cuts.
